dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge following a non-linear spline curve from the apex to the posterior base insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius, classified as obtuse-rounded at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness of the anterior margin relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a consistent radius fitting the anterior-dorsal cranial profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby beak extension with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1:1.2 extending from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the transition point where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters on the lateral flank; slight irregular notch visible on the posterior margin of the caudal fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible eye aperture with distinct concentric tonal gradients; single visible pectoral fin with a falcate trailing edge and tapered tip.
